goal: Remediate the two independently-verified RFCs from the 5638f86d reverse-spec review: bounded/streamed Postgres->JSONL extraction in build_profiles (RFC-005) and pytest discovery for the profile-builder test module (RFC-006).
success_criteria: tests/batch/profile_builder/test_builder.py is collected and passes under default pytest discovery (testpaths=["tests"], no python_files override)
build_profiles no longer calls .scalars().all() for either the historical or the recent window; both stream to temp JSONL in bounded chunks via execution_options(yield_per=chunk_size)
Zero remaining references to events_recent / events_hist in batch/profile_builder/builder.py
build_profiles gains a trailing keyword chunk_size: int = _BUILD_EXTRACT_CHUNK_SIZE (5000); all existing positional/keyword call sites remain valid unchanged
New regression test forces multiple chunks (chunk_size=2 over 5 rows) and asserts every row lands in the aggregate
Full suite green (pytest -v --tb=short --ignore=tests/live) and ruff clean at the exit gate
constraints: No scoring weight or threshold changes in config/scoring_config.yaml (evaluation-first discipline; this is a memory/IO bounding change, not detection logic)
build_profiles public signature stays backward compatible: any new parameter is a trailing keyword with a default
Streamed JSONL rows must be byte-for-byte equivalent to the current write_jsonl closure; do not add a per-entity ordering guarantee that does not exist today
Do not touch evidence/ or unrelated pre-existing untracked artifacts in the repo root (AS_BUILT.md, DEBT_LEDGER.md, *-rfcs.md, *-run_log.md, scratch/*.log)
RFC-001 is rejected (fabricated premise) and RFC-002/003 KILL dispositions are affirmed: no packet may implement them

risks.risk: yield_per is incompatible with the eager/subquery loading or the sqlite in-memory test fixture, raising InvalidRequestError
risks.mitigation: stmt_hist/stmt_recent are plain selects over ResolvedEventModel with no eager loaders; R2 regression test exercises chunk_size=2 on the sqlite fixture and would surface the error immediately

risks.risk: Empty-recent-window behavior changes: old code skipped creating the recent temp file, new code creates then unlinks it
risks.mitigation: temp_file_recent set back to None when count_recent == 0, and every later 'if events_recent:' guard rewritten to 'if temp_file_recent:'; existing snapshot/shadow/geo/escalation tests cover the empty-recent path

risks.risk: Early-return path (no historical events) leaks the just-created hist temp file
risks.mitigation: Plan mandates temp_file_hist.unlink(missing_ok=True) before the early return; verifier must confirm no stray temp_events_*.jsonl after the suite

risks.risk: Newly-discovered test_builder.py collides with another test_builder.py or fails once actually executed in CI
risks.mitigation: R1 Step 1 captures pre-rename collect-only evidence; Step 4 runs the full suite to catch import file mismatch

rules: Update state.json packet status before memory-bank mirrors

packets.label: sprint:R|fix|rfc-005-bounded-extraction
packets.objective: Replace both full .scalars().all() materializations in build_profiles with a chunked _stream_events_to_jsonl helper using execution_options(yield_per=chunk_size), bounding Python-side memory to one chunk regardless of window size.

research.reason: Plan supplies the full implementation inline (helper, constant, signature, call sites). Single path, no fork; researcher would add latency without changing the decision.

code_review.disposition: Note 1 (missing ': int' on _BUILD_EXTRACT_CHUNK_SIZE, a deviation from the plan's stated interface) fixed in follow-up commit 019487e. Notes 2 and 3 accepted as-is: sqlite cannot prove server-side round-trips, and partial-file cleanup on mid-stream exceptions relies on the pre-existing finally block that this diff does not worsen.

packets.notes: 2026-07-30 DONE: RED captured first (TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'chunk_size') before any builder.py edit. _BUILD_EXTRACT_CHUNK_SIZE: int = 5000 + _stream_events_to_jsonl with execution_options(yield_per=chunk_size); both .scalars().all() extractions removed; zero events_hist/events_recent references remain; downstream guard now 'if temp_file_recent:'. Row payload byte-equivalent to the deleted write_jsonl closure (verifier diffed against 2aaa4e0^). Suite 164 -> 165 passed, ruff clean, no stray temp_events_*.jsonl. Skeptic disproved test vacuity by inserting a break after the first chunk (failed assert 2 == 5) and restored the tree clean. Verdict: survives.
